corrections.baseline: Duktape 1.2.2 (the copy vendored in scriptorium's javascript/duktape; PUC Lua at 1.341 s in the same table is faster than mruby)

corrections.claimed_speedup: 2.098 s versus Duktape 1.2.2 at 9.544 s, about 4.5x faster than Duktape (derived from page data); in bench.csv's earlier session the ratio was about 3.1x (4.641 s vs 14.301 s, derived from page data). Slower than PUC Lua at 1.341 s (about 1.6x, derived from page data).
corrections.caveats: Eleven-year-old snapshot (July 2015) of mruby (include/mruby/version.h reports 1.1.1) on one recursive-fib(34) test; the author says 'Take it with a grain of salt'. bench.exe times whole processes with system() (start-up included), averages 5 launches, never checks the output, and the README table keeps the minimum over separate non-interleaved sessions (bench.csv has mruby at 4.641 s and 2.098 s, Duktape at 14.30, 10.29 and 9.544 s plus unlabelled Duktape runs of 9.06 to 9.71 s). Duktape 1.2.2 is much older than current Duktape 2.x releases, and PUC Lua (1.341 s in the same table) is faster than mruby. In taksatou/embench (embedding-call overhead, i7-2600S) mruby is slower than Lua on both tests (echo 100000: 36.1 ms vs 15.2 ms; invert 100000: 1260.6 ms vs 505.4 ms).

notes: Numbers match README row 19 and bench.csv line 75 exactly; Duktape and mruby were built with the same /Ox /Oy /MT /DNDEBUG flags, so the record's 'per-engine flags not stated' was wrong and is corrected. Metadata confirmed on github.com: MIT, 5.6k stars, not archived, last commit 2026-10-06. Shortcomings to record: one 2015 fib micro-benchmark, beats only Duktape 1.2.2 and is about 1.6x slower than PUC Lua, start-up included, mruby also slower than Lua in embench.
